title: Airbnb Payout Failure Rate
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:payout
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(payout_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by listing_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Airbnb payout records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each listing.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize payout_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per listing.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which parts of your Airbnb payout data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
